question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution: The correct answer is **"massive"** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** __ • In the given passage, the most appropriate answer for blank no. 1 is **'massive.'** • **Massive: **very large in size, amount, or number.(आकार, मात्रा या संख्या में बहुत बड़ा) • **Example**: *They have a **massive** house. * • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is **option 2.** **​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words given in the options. • Lesser: not as great in size, amount, or importance. (आकार, मात्रा या संख्या में बहुत बड़ा नहीं) • Example: A lesser man might have given up at that point. • Trivial: has little value or importance. (इसका बहुत कम मूल्य या महत्व है) • Example: I don't know why he gets so upset about something so trivial. • Minor: has little importance, influence, or effect. (इसका महत्व, प्रभाव या प्रभाव बहुत कम है) • Example: It is only a minor problem. 43:Tc6f, The correct answer is **"source"**
